feature_overlap.interpretation: Low feature ranking agreement (Spearman ρ≈0, Jaccard≈0.29) indicates LGB and XGB rely on different feature subsets. LGB emphasizes EXT_SOURCE composites (MEDIAN, STD, PROD) while XGB uses broader spread including EXT_SOURCE_MAX, ratios, and balance metrics. This architectural difference (LGB leaf-wise histogram binning vs XGB depth-wise growth) accounts for performance gap.

gap_analysis.summary: Gap of 0.1205 Gini vs XGBoost exceeds 0.03 threshold. Learning curve shows LGB converges early (624 estimators, Gini=0.4362) with limited headroom to XGBoost (0.5567). Feature overlap analysis reveals minimal ranking correlation (-0.0068), suggesting LGB and XGBoost solve the problem via different feature importance hierarchies. Structural gap likely due to algorithm differences rather than hyperparameter insufficiency.
